summary.text: Stacey Carroll is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 64th District since January 14, 2026.
The district covers part of Stafford County.
The House profile lists Stacey Carroll's occupation as certified public accountant.

paragraphs.text: Stacey Carroll was born in Saint Petersburg, FL.
The profile lists the University of South Florida (finance and accounting, 2012) and Webster University (finance, 2016) under education.
It lists current service in the Army National Guard.
The profile lists membership in Mount Zion Baptist Church, the National Association for Black Accountants, the Virginia Society of CPAs and the American Society of CPAs.
Stacey Carroll serves on the Finance, Privileges and Elections, and General Laws committees.
